_comment: Self-contained GitHub daemon profile. Select with `CodeReviewDaemon --review achieveai`. Reviews achieveai/LmDotnetTools through the achieveai/AchieveAiReviews cross-repo store (tool-assisted, sub-agents). Two-model split: the dispatcher/state orchestrator loop runs ReviewModelId (gpt-5.6-luna); the code-reviewer:* review sub-agents run SubAgentModelId (gpt-5.6-sol), which the daemon sends to the review host at conversation provision and the host applies per spawn at this rung: spawn-model > spawn-tier > SubAgentModelId > template-model > template-tier > ReviewModelId. Until that channel existed (#529) this sentence described an intent, not a behaviour: SubAgentModelId had no reader anywhere, so every sub-agent ran the orchestrator's model. It takes effect only on a review host running this build or newer, from that host's next restart. LIVE-POSTING: EnableCommentPosting is true ⇒ this profile is the deployed Revobot poster (crd-daemon-revobot) and POSTS review comments to the PR. It shares port 5080 + the review-pool with that daemon, so run only ONE poster at a time — do NOT launch this alongside crd-daemon-revobot. For a local dry run that posts nothing, set EnableCommentPosting:false. Machine-specific absolute paths below; this is a fresh instance (its own .run DB) — point DatabasePath at crd-daemon-revobot/review-opus.db to continue that daemon's history.

Github._comment: GitHub CLI (gh) first-party OAuth App id + secret (public, safe to embed — same convention as LmStreaming.Sample). Required so SandboxSessionRegistry attaches the github-auth egress rule for the sandbox; the auth-webhook then injects the EXISTING stored token (crd-oauth-tokens/github.json, scopes repo/read:org/workflow/gist) for the review agent's api.github.com calls (code-reviewer:post-pr-review).
